title: Creamy Steak Gnocchi Soup
summary: Rich, parmesan-laced gnocchi stew with kale and juicy seared sirloin on top.
difficulty_reason: Cooking steaks while building a reduced, cream-finished broth takes some timing.

ingredients.line: 24 oz top sirloin or thin-cut NY strip steaks
1/2 to 1 cup grated parmesan, plus more to serve
Freshly cracked black pepper, to taste

steps: Heat the olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Saute the onion 4 to 5 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in the wine, scrape up the browned bits, and simmer 3 to 5 minutes until reduced by about half.
Add the beef stock and thyme and simmer uncovered until reduced by about half.
Meanwhile, season the steaks and cook them in a separate skillet or on a grill to your desired doneness. Rest 5 to 10 minutes, then slice into bite-size pieces and set half aside for topping.
Stir the kale and any steak resting juices into the broth and cook 2 to 3 minutes until wilted.
Add the gnocchi and cook 3 to 4 minutes, or per package directions, until tender.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer 1 to 2 minutes until the broth thickens slightly.
Remove the thyme sprigs, lower the heat, and stir in the cream and parmesan. Season with salt and pepper and keep at a gentle heat, never a hard boil.
Stir in half the steak, ladle into bowls, and top with the rest of the steak, more parmesan and black pepper.
tips: Keep the soup below a hard boil after adding the cream so it stays smooth.
Rest the steaks before slicing so they stay juicy.
source_notes: Ingredients and method from the caption, matching the voiceover.
